title: Feed A Crowd: Vego Sloppy Joes
subtitle: Same Meal Price, More Servings!
description: Want extra bang for your buck? Serve up more with our Feed A Crowd recipes. We've added more hearty ingredients like filling carbs and veggies to satisfy hungry tummies. If you’re on a 2-person plan, these recipes make 4 portions; on a 4-person plan, they make 8 portions.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line a large oven tray with baking paper. Scrub the unpeeled sweet potatoes, then cut into 3cm chunks (see Feed A Crowd). Thinly slice the onion. Thinly slice the cabbage with a mandoline or sharp knife. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Drain and rinse the beans.

Roast sweet potato gems: Put the sweet potato on the lined tray, drizzle with 1 tbs olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Roast for 25-30 mins until tender. Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a large deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion and garlic, stirring occasionally, for 3 mins or until softened.

Simmer beans: Add the country seasoning and 2 tbs barbecue sauce to the onion mixture and cook, stirring, for 30 secs. Add the passata, beans and 60ml (¼ cup) water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until the sauce is slightly thickened. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Remove the pan from the heat.

Toast bread rolls: Meanwhile, cut the bread rolls in half. Put on a large oven tray, cut side up, and bake for 5-6 mins until lightly toasted. Combine 2 tbs mayonnaise and 1 tbs water in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the cabbage and toss to coat.
Serve up: Divide the bean mixture and cabbage among the bread roll bases, then sandwich with the tops. Serve with the sweet potato gems and enjoy!
Feed A Crowd: Prefer fries with that? Just cut the sweet potatoes into thick fries instead.
